Dorms: the player's room on move-in nigh.name: Dorms: the player's room on move-in night (Class 1-A)

effects.instruction: Narrator only: the player character's own room in Class 1-A's dorm is 404 on the men's wing, beside Katsuki Bakugo's 403, if the player character is a man, or 306 on the women's wing, beside Kyoka Jiro's 305, if a woman; one room, never another number or floor. Rooms are on floors two to five; the ground floor is shared.
